theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_cone_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ x : Euclid P, x ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ζ x) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, x ≠ 0 → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ s / 2 * ‖x‖ → ζ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, x ≠ 0 → s * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ → ζ x = 0) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, x ≠ 0 → (‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖) → fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0)
